response:
Going through a breakup is incredibly painful, especially when you feel misunderstood or dismissed as being "too emotional." It is completely natural to want closure and to hope that someone you care about will be understanding and willing to talk things through. 

While it would be ideal for him to be more communicative, his silence is a boundary he is setting right now. You cannot control how he responds to his own stress or to the breakup, and continuing to text him when he is ignoring you will likely only prolong your own pain. Instead of focusing on what he should do, try to redirect that energy toward your own healing. Your feelings are valid, and you deserve to be heard. It might help to share these emotions with a trusted friend, family member, or counselor who can give you the safe, supportive space you need during this difficult time.
